tagline: Advancing high-grade uranium exploration in the Athabasca Basin
hero_kpi_rationale: The flagship KPI reflects the discovery of exceptional uranium grades (up to 85.4% U3O8), a strong signal of the Pike Zone's potential in Athabasca Basin uranium exploration.

kpis.name: Maximum Uranium Grade
kpis.explanation: The highest grade found in drill core samples, measured as a percentage of U3O8.
kpis.description: Drilling has revealed extremely high grades, including 5.5 meters at 53.90% U3O8, indicating exceptional potential for the Pike Zone project.
kpis.signal: Among the highest grades ever observed in uranium exploration.

kpis.name: Mineralization Strike Length
kpis.explanation: Total length of the mineralized zone identified by drilling, in meters.
kpis.description: Mineralization extends over 500 meters and remains open, suggesting possible extensions in future drilling.
kpis.signal: Mineralized zone open in both directions, significant expansion potential.

kpis.name: Cash Position
kpis.explanation: Amount of cash held by the company to fund its exploration activities.
kpis.description: The company holds CAD 34.1 million in cash, enabling funding of planned exploration and drilling programs.
kpis.signal: Sufficient cash to fund a drilling program and exploration operations.
